summary: Validated the 2 UX bugs + new AT client order form feature. Backend: 6/6 pytest passing (blank AT form PDF endpoint returns 99KB inline PDF with all door models, and Content-Disposition is inline on all PDF endpoints while CSV export stays attachment). Frontend: BUG#1 auto-select confirmed working (typing '5' on a pre-filled '0' number input produces '5', not '05'), 'Formulaire client vierge' button present on /admin/gestion/commandes-at, and compose-attach-at-form button correctly attaches Portech-Formulaire-commande-porte-AT.pdf (96.9 kB) in the compose email panel. Regression pages (fabrication, soumissions, factures, rapports) load with no errors.

issues: input[type=number] does not expose selectionStart/End (browser spec), so pure programmatic assertion is not possible. Verified functionally via keyboard.press('5') → value becomes '5' not '05'. Works as intended.

critical_code_review_comments: App.js focusin handler correctly narrows to input[type="number"] and uses el.select() inside setTimeout(0) — safe against mobile keyboard races. No memory leak (cleanup returns removeEventListener). ✓
erp_routes_at_order_form.py: uses asyncio.to_thread to render the PDF, keeping the event loop free — good pattern. Endpoint is auth-protected via auth_dep. ✓
Content-Disposition change is consistent: all PDF endpoints inline, all CSV endpoints still attachment (verified for /admin/mosquito-screens.csv). ✓

AT form PDF contains AT1000/ATi1000/AT2000/ATi2000 + Portech branding; passes semantic content check. Anodisé / Bronze / Champagne finishes not always extractable via pypdf due to Unicode checkbox glyphs but manual PDF inspection would confirm — not a blocker.
seed_data_creation: None — read-only tests + one dynamic list-scan for existing mosquito/expert/cut items to test their PDF headers.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend PDF/AT-form tests at /app/backend/tests/test_pdf_inline_and_at_form.py. Run with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env var set. Uses same PortechAdmin creds. The at-order-form.pdf endpoint returns ~99 KB PDF with inline Content-Disposition. Frontend testids: at-orders-form-btn (Commandes AT page), compose-attach-at-form + compose-attachments (Courriel page). BUG#1 auto-select verified by keyboard.press flow — input[type=number] does not report selectionStart so DO NOT assert on selection API; assert on resulting value after typing.
